name: design_sgrna
description: Design CRISPR sgRNA guides for a target DNA sequence, scanning both strands for PAM sites
usage: from app.tools.biomni.molecular_biology import design_sgrna; result = design_sgrna('ATGGCTAGCTAGCGATCGATCGATCGATCGATCGATCGA', pam='NGG', top_k=10)

parameters.target_sequence: str — DNA sequence to target (must include PAM context)
parameters.pam: str — PAM sequence: 'NGG' for SpCas9, 'NNGRRT' for SaCas9 (default 'NGG')
parameters.top_k: int — number of top guides to return (default 10)

returns: dict with keys: pam, guide_length, total_guides_found, top_guides (list of {sequence, pam, position, gc_content, off_target_score, strand})
